name: Plant Nerd Prepackaged Flower Jar | Deep Fried Ice Cream
description: This strain lives up to its hype. The cross is Ice Cream Cake x Deep Breath and was bred by Bulletproof Genetics here in Michigan. The pheno we’re growing has a gassy, melony terp profile; think of cantaloupe mixed with the OG freshness of Deep Breath. Why we’re growing it is simple: it has a unique fruity nose, it tastes great, and it smokes great. Can’t really get much better than that.
